title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Saturday, 6 June 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: As hot summer, blackouts loom, Iraq looks to solar power
highlights.summary: With so much sunlight, Iraq is very well-positioned to use solar power to help fix its annual summer electricity crisis. So why is it that Iraq's government has only recently started to take solar power seriously?

highlights.headline: ‘Immediate national priority’: ministers accused of complacency over UK food supply
highlights.summary: <p>Cold storage and logistics body warns food supplies at risk from fuel shortages, cyber attacks and extreme weather</p><p>Ministers have been accused of being complacent about the risks to vital supplies of food into the UK amid concerns over fuel shortages, cyber attacks and extreme weather.</p><p>The trade body for cold storage and logistics has urged the government to make potential disruption to the UK’s food system an “immediate national priority”.</p>

highlights.headline: Trump to meet AI leaders to discuss US investment in their companies
highlights.summary: The US president said on Friday he expects to meet the leaders of top AI companies next week.
